correctness.rationale: On the zero-sum subspace the irreducible Laplacian is positive definite; in its eigenbasis the second variation of the inverse trace is a sum of 2|H_ij|^2/(lambda_i^2 lambda_j), positive for a nonzero symmetric zero-sum perturbation. Coordinate-permutation averaging preserves connectedness and strict convexity forces any optimum to be invariant. The three rates alpha, beta and alpha+beta have multiplicities p-1, q-1 and (p-1)(q-1), respectively; both rates must be positive. The budget saturates by positive common scaling. Differentiating the saturated objective gives the positive prefactor in RESULT.md times q t^4+2q t^3-2pt-p. The quotient t^3(t+2)/(2t+1) increases from zero to infinity, so the critical point is the global minimum. For fixed p the equation gives t=(p/(2q))^(1/3)(1+O(q^(-1/3))). Substitution into the exact value expression leaves pq plus (p-1)/t+(p-1)q t^2/p+O(1), giving the stated coefficient. For p=2, averaging cannot increase ||P-J||, and the averaged candidate with SLEM r must have alpha,beta>=1-r and alpha+beta<=1+r. This forces r>=1/3; the stated feasible design attains it. Multiplicity substitution gives (9q-3)/4 and the ratio tends to 9/8. This is a statement about the specified optimal mixing design. The checker was inspected, not executed; the argument is analytic.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Scale the conductance-budget result by pq/2. Its unique optimum then has incident conductance 1 at every vertex, so it gives a zero-holding stochastic walk. Every competing stochastic walk has budget at most pq/2; if smaller it can be scaled to pq/2 in the conductance comparison class, reducing the inverse trace. Holding contributes nothing to I-P beyond the off-diagonal edge Laplacian. Thus this is global entailment, not just an optimizer within a symmetric ansatz.
